This '''general''' was commander of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] ground forces in and around the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Tiems]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He led four regiments of soldiers against three regiments of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] troops during the [[Battle of Tiems]], losing two in an ambush carefully laid by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Carlist Rieekan/Legends|Carlist Rieekan]]. Retreating to Tiems, he reinforced his troops with four regiments of native troops, but refused to attack&mdash;with three-to-one odds&mdash;until he could be sure of air cover. By the time he renewed his assault, Rieekan and his troops had been extracted.
